notes: Daily distance targets include ordinary stops and sleep; extra delays are additional.
Retail ETAs include an estimated outward detour; finish ETAs do not automatically add shopping detours or queues.
Opening hours are published weekly schedules, not a promise of service. Restaurant opening does not establish kitchen hours.
Mapped drinking-water points have unverified operability; water availability is not guaranteed.
Official PDF cut-offs and all 29 numbered instructions are included. Artenara is an aid checkpoint, not a sleeping lifebase.
The supplied GPX measures 249.373km; the official PDF retains 254.11km. Course geometry is not stretched.
Resupply uses dated OSM/operator snapshots with approaches recalculated on the official course; unmapped final entrance offsets remain estimates.

resupply_audit.method: Shortest mapped pedestrian-network approach from OSM nodes within 3m of the official GPX; attachment and final entrance offsets are estimates, not drawn as invented connecting trails. Graph/places dated 24–25 October 2026. One shortest network attachment per venue; repeated-pass opportunities beyond that attachment are not exhaustively enumerated.

route_comparison.method: Horizontal WGS84 geodesic chainage; elevation sampled at 25m, Gaussian sigma 50m; overlap sampled by chainage every 25m and measured against full projected UTM28N polylines, separately in each direction. No distance rescaling or geographic snapping.
limitations: Official PDF retains a 254.11km distance; the supplied official GPX measures shorter. Both are retained.
GPX metadata includes an old software timestamp; course authority follows the supplied 2026 filenames, organiser PDF and runner identification, not that timestamp.
The coastal alternative in rough seas is an instruction, not supplied alternate geometry.
